description: Opening turn: prose establishes the scene — clock time, location, and weather all appear for the first time.
user_msg: I climb down from the coach and look around the square.
turn: The coach rattles to a halt at the edge of the night market. Rain beads on the striped awnings, and the guild-hall clock reads 14:35.
notes: BTS Env Tracking header '[ Time | Location | Weather ]' sets all three at scene open. Time is normalized from the preset's 'h:mm tt' display to the schema's 24h HH:MM; location is the bare token behind BTS '@night_market'; weather is the descriptor Env Tracking carries. 'climb' resolves to travel.
